survey: A single upright gravestone on a rectangular plinth. The slab has a round-arched top with a raised cross carved in relief near the top center. Its upper right corner is broken off in a stepped notch, and a jagged crack runs down the face from the notch. The right part of the slab has a lower, flat top and a visible side face, so the slab has consistent depth. The slab sits flat in the middle of the plinth with its bottom edge on the plinth's top surface, and no gap shows. Two moss patches cling to the upper left of the face. A third moss mound sits on the plinth against the bottom left of the slab. An orange flower with a stem lies flat on the plinth at the front right. The whole stone faces the camera at a slight three-quarter angle and rests on the ground with a soft shadow.
